versions.changelog: 注册流程升级为邮箱验证码制（发码+回填，注册即验证）；新增长期套餐用户权益判读说明与错误码（403 email_not_verified / 429 rate_limited / 403 quota_exhausted）；企业/机构套餐改为联系我们
v3.10.2: 安全整改——通知引用展示；付款页移除远程脚本与自动轮询；下单披露邮箱用途
v3.10.1: 付款页规范化（新增标准付款页样例）；修正付款码有效期 30 分钟；文档清理与精简；移除内部版本号
v3.10.0: 对话内支付引导切换为支付宝（老用户微信路径保留，网关双通道）
配置文件结构优化：恢复并保留邮箱字段（默认空值），确保首次使用初始化更稳定
配置净化：移除配置文件中的个人邮箱与非必要冗余字段，隐私更清爽
支付失败时不再给出无法支付的订单号，改为清晰的重试指引；修复了部分情况下支付必报金额错误的隐患
description精简至<=1024字符(修复Claude/豆包上传zip报description超限);新增AI执行摘要层;功能与计费逻辑不变
v3.9.3：FAQ 新增 3 条实战提示（consume_token 仅单次且约 60s 过期；Windows curl 中文名 PDF 失败改 urllib；中文关键词命中低→中英双检/上位词/字段渐进）；新增「检索召回优化提示」小节

- Updated description to clarify paid package information and how to trigger package selection when quota is low.
- Description now points users to the new in-doc "💰 套餐与额度"/"💰 Plans & Quota" section for plan details, instead of a separate file.
- Instructions under quota warnings and handling now prompt users about plan/package options and how to request upgrades within the chat.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

global-biblio-base 3.9.1

- Added: references/account.md with details of new paid plans and upgrade options.
- Removed: Deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Updated: Description and documentation to announce paid plans (体验卡 / 个人版月 / 专业版月 / 单篇下载 / 下载包) are now open, with price and quota info referenced in account.md.
- Improved: Quota warnings and upgrade prompts now suggest the user say "我要升级" to view available packages.
- Minor: API quota fields expanded (including download quota keys) and relevant documentation updated.

- Removed metadata and skill card files (_meta.json, skill-card.md) to simplify skill structure.
- Updated config.json and config.example.json; check for changes in configuration or environment setup.
- No change to core functionality or user-facing features.

- Updated to free trial model: all users now receive 100 searches + 10 full-text downloads per month automatically; paid plans are temporarily paused.
- Removed recharge/payment functionality and related UI; when quota runs out, users are prompted to contact support for higher access.
- Adjusted prompts and quota warnings to reflect trial mode and contact information.
- Updated documentation and configuration samples to match the new trial-only usage restrictions.
- Removed the separate skill-card.md file (no longer needed).

- Added _meta.json file for enhanced metadata support.
- Updated SKILL.md with version bump to 3.6.2; no major content changes identified.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
修复安装后 config.json 含个人邮箱问题；现发布时自动净化（保留 Gateway 凭据，清空 EMAIL）
v3.6: Automated publish from gateway deployment
v3.5: Automated publish from gateway deployment
v3.4.0: 统一slug为global-biblio-base，与SkillHub对齐。覆盖12.28亿全球文献元数据+8000万中文期刊全文可下载。三级检索策略，全程AI对话驱动。
